stem.text: A radioactive source produces a beam of $\alpha$-particles in a vacuum. The average current caused by the $\alpha$-particles in the beam is $1.5 \times 10^{-9}\,\text{A}$.
The beam is incident on a metal target.
What is the average number of $\alpha$-particles hitting the metal target in a time of $3.0\,\text{s}$?
